description: Use this when the user asks what to order from one of their saved ChefBear menus and their tastes, dislikes, allergies or diets matter. Ranks the menu's dishes against the user's saved taste profile (when this connection may read it) plus any preferences you pass from the conversation, and lists dishes whose printed text mentions a stated allergy or dislike as excluded, with the reason. It matches the menu's text only and does not decide diets, so check the picks against the user's diets and suggest confirming allergens and ingredients with the restaurant. Read-only; does not use the recognition allowance.

limit.description: How many dishes to recommend. Defaults to 5.

menuId.description: The menuId from list_menus or get_import_status, or the menu's https://chef-bear.com/my-menu/ link.

preferences.description: Preferences the user stated in this conversation, used together with the saved profile.

allergies.description: Allergies or intolerances the user stated for themselves, such as peanuts or shellfish, to consider.

diets.description: Diets the user follows, to consider.

dislikes.description: Foods or ingredients the user doesn't want, to consider.

levels.description: Taste levels from 1 (not at all) to 5 (very much): spicy, oily, sweet, meat and adventure (trying unfamiliar dishes).

likes.description: Foods, dishes, ingredients or cuisines the user likes, to consider.

useSavedProfile.description: false: ignore the saved taste profile for this call. Defaults to true.

name: recommend_dishes

profileUsed.description: Whether the user's saved taste profile was used.

title: Recommend dishes from a menu
